name: Lausanne

queries.query: Lausanne official cadastral map parcel GIS Vaud cadastre
queries.result: Official Canton of Vaud cadastral viewer and City of Lausanne map viewer found; the Canton states the official viewer publishes public geodata and exposes consultation WMS services.

queries.query: Lausanne cadastre officiel plan cadastral géoportail parcelles
queries.result: Official French-language Vaud parcel-localisation page documents the official cadastral parcel layer, weekly updates, and Lausanne parcel search; the City viewer lists Mensuration officielle - Cadastre, N° de parcelles and Biens-fonds.

registryBasis: The Canton of Vaud Direction du cadastre et de la géoinformation is the evidenced cadastral custodian; the official Canton and City viewers publish/consult official parcel data.
custodian: Direction du cadastre et de la géoinformation, État de Vaud; City of Lausanne viewer

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official Swiss CadastralWebMap with Vaud cadastral parcel coverage; bounded response proves only the queried Lausanne map window.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Anonymous identify request returned two parcel polygons in the bounded Lausanne extent.

uncertainty: The exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted. The sample request used a nearby bounded EPSG:2056 map window and is evidence of service availability and parcel schema, not a citywide completeness claim. CadastralWebMap attributes expose both a numeric service feature id and native EGRID; the retained sample uses EGRID as the canonical native identity.
nextStep: Serial reviewer should independently qualify the adapter, including CRS conversion, stable EGRID identity handling, and city-window coverage before runtime admission.
